title: Storey Architecture journal
description: A huge two-line heading at the left with a paragraph and a small black button far to the right, then a two-column grid of posts aligned at the top: each a photo (square, 4:3 or tall) with a two-line title and a small black Read button under it. Photos are uncovered from black as they enter, drift inside their frames and show a pointer-following label on hover.
notes: each post sets its own frame ratio; the original pairs 1:1 with 4:3, then 4:3 with 6:7
the pointer-following label needs JavaScript (hydrate: visible)
